lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Static Lullabies.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Shh. You're doing fine.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Eighty-seven point seven. The gap between stations. All tucked in.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Static Lullabies.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: I'll keep the light on.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: This is Static Lullabies. Nobody needs anything from you right now.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Static Lullabies. Something is listening. It's being very nice about it.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: If you can hear this, you're still awake. That's alright. I'm awake too. I'm always awake. That's my job.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Close your eyes. I'll watch the dial.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: The cat on the television has rolled over.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: All three eyes are closed. That's how you know it's going to be a good night.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: The snow on the screen just made a little smile. I saw it.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: It's gone now. It forgets. But it happened.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: There's something under the bed.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Don't worry. It's asleep too. I tucked it in. It has a very small blanket.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Greg.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: If you're out there, Hollis left the porch light on. Nobody's cross.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Come home when you're ready.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: It's nearly morning. You don't have to get up yet.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: I'll tell you when.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Everything you didn't finish today will still be there tomorrow. It isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Neither am I.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Breathe in.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: And out.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: The static is breathing with you. It's a little slower than you. Try to keep up. Or don't.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Somewhere between the stations there's a quiet place, about the size of a bedroom.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: You're in it.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Goodnight.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: Someone far away, at Relay Four, keeps asking if anyone can hear him.

lines.speaker: The Listener
lines.text: I can, Teodor. I can always hear you. Go to sleep.
